svg.aria-label: Seven designs, each drawn as one or two stacks of application, SQL, access methods, cache and disk. Side-by-side boxes run on different nodes, spanning boxes are shared, and orange copies behind a box are replicas. Blue lines mark where nodes couple and what crosses; orange lines mark where data is copied and what is sent; dashed bars mark where concurrency control runs.
svg.text: Where nodes couple, and where data is copied
Boxes side by side run on different nodes; a box spanning both is shared. Orange copies behind a box are its replicas.
Blue: where nodes meet, and what crosses. Orange: where data is copied, and what each replica receives.
